ARCANE.notes: Two Forever sources agree on Hit > Spell Power > Crit > Int, then MP5/Spirit (Icy Veins puts MP5 ahead of Spirit, wow.gg the reverse). Forever changes: Arcane Mind now grants Intellect and doubles Arcane crit bonus damage, so CRIT and INT are worth more than in classic; Arcane Meditation goes up to 50% (Spirit a bit better); Arcane Blast is mana hungry. Crit and Hit are unified for all attack types in Forever, so CRIT=SCRIT and HIT=SHIT. Haste exists in Forever and Icy Veins calls it valuable but rare; omitted because no source ranks it. Per-1% weights exceed SP per point by design; ordering holds per item-budget (1% crit/hit costs roughly 14-16 SP of budget). INT->crit uses the classic-era 59.5 INT per 1% at 60 (gap fill).
